{{Quote|The Zarracines refused to accommodate Coruscant's envoys and on the verge of capture the entire ruling council killed themselves to avoid conversion and spite their conquerors. In retaliation, Commodore Daymont "Veracity" Praji bombed Zarracina III into radioactive winter.|Dr. Gabrel Treon, "Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes"|<ref name="Tinker" />}}
In [[11,660 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] carried out a '''bombardment''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zarracina III]]. At the [[Time/Legends|time]], the Republic was under the control of the [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] [[Pius Dea]] cult, and it attempted to gain control of the planet after a strategically important [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace jump point/Legends|jump point]] was discovered in the [[Zarracina system/Legends|Zarracina system]]. When the [[Zarracina III ruling council|ruling council]] of the planet's [[Zarracine]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Death/Legends|died]] by suicide rather than be captured, Republic [[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]] [[Daymont Praji]] ordered that Zarracina III be subjected to an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]]. It caused [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] [[Winter/Legends|winter]] on the planet, and the Zarracines were rendered nearly [[Speciecide|extinct]], going on to harbor resentment toward the Republic and the [[House Praji/Legends|Prajis]] that lasted for tens of [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|But long before the end, in 11,660 BBY, a stable hyperspace jump point was discovered in the Zarracina system, and acquiring its inhabited third planet became a priority for the Republic.|Dr. Gabrel Treon, "Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes"|<ref name="Tinker" />}}
[[File:Twelfth_Pius_Dea_Crusade.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The bombardment of Zarracina III occurred as part of the Twelfth Pius Dea Crusade.]]
During the [[Pius Dea Era]], a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] lasting between approximately [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was under the control of the [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] [[Pius Dea]] cult.<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> In [[11,660 BBY]], a stable [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace jump point/Legends|jump point]] was discovered in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Zarracina system/Legends|Zarracina system]]. Due to the discovery's strategic nature, acquiring the inhabited [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zarracina III]] became a priority for the Republic. When the [[Zarracine]]s, the native [[Species/Legends|species]] of Zarracina III, rejected [[Envoy/Legends|envoys]] from<ref name="Tinker" /> the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Republic initiated a [[Twelfth Pius Dea Crusade|crusade]] against the natives of the Zarracina [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==The bombardment==
On the verge of capture by the Republic, the entire [[Zarracina III ruling council|ruling council]] of Zarracina III [[Death/Legends|died]] by suicide in order to avoid conversion to the Pius Dea religion and to spite the would-be Republic conquerors. In response, Republic [[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]] [[Daymont Praji]] ordered that the planet be subjected to [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]].<ref name="Tinker" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|The Republic annexed the system and the few surviving Zarracines became a nomadic species. Harboring much hatred for the destroyers of their world, they kept to themselves, although many joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems and later Nolaa Tarkona's Diversity Alliance.|Dr. Gabrel Treon, "Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes"|<ref name="Tinker" />}}
The bombardment of Zarracina III sent the planet into a state of [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] [[Winter/Legends|winter]]. It also caused the [[Speciecide|near-extinction]] of the Zarracines, with the few remaining [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] adopting a nomadic existence and nurturing hatred for the Republic&mdash;which subsequently annexed the Zarracina system&mdash;and the [[House Praji/Legends|Praji family]] that lasted for more than ten [[Millennium/Legends|thousand years]]. In [[104 ABY]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Gabrel Treon]] mentioned the bombardment of Zarracina III in the article "[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes]]," published in the [[Byblos Journal of Historical Science]].<ref name="Tinker" />

==Behind the scenes==
The bombardment of Zarracina III was mentioned in "[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]," an article authored by [[Nathan O'Keefe]] and published as part of the [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature on [[February 5]], [[2009]].<ref name="Tinker" />
